feature_projection: global label-blind 95%-variance PCA per layer and stream
ridge_policy: lambda = alpha times the mean eigenvalue of the label-blind total covariance on the projected coordinates
null: all 12,870 balanced task assignments; maximize over every declared layer and stream for each assignment
outputs: selection-aware maximum and exact p-value for every alpha
observed selected layer and stream for every alpha
agreement with the unwhitened trace-ratio site
numerical_gate: Sherman-Morrison scores must match direct regularized pooled-within covariance inversion on synthetic and sampled real assignments
provenance_limit: This grid was chosen after the primary, trace-ratio, matched-excess, and external-review results were known. It is a selector sensitivity, not a replacement primary analysis.
claim_limit: A stable site under this grid would not establish causal localization. Cross-panel replication requires the corresponding raw panel activations and remains separate.
